sources.note: Record read (PHOIBLE contributor table and inventory datatable): the Gade-Lohar entry lists 50 segments = 31 consonants + 19 vowels (oral and nasal vowels, breathy-voiced stops) and Tones = 0, whereas the same compilation records tonemes for tonal languages (Angami 5, Ao 3, Apatani 3, Boro 2); i.e. no tonemes are posited for Gade Lohar, secondhand from Sharma 1988, whose own suprasegmental section (Google Books snippets, p.11) treats pitch as three intonational pitch levels plus terminal contours. Book text not opened, so no quotable statement.
